setup: The ratio is \(r = [[ratio]]\), and the series is \(1 + r + r^2 + \cdots\).

steps.say: The modulus of the ratio is \(1/[[k]] < 1\), so the series converges.
The sum is \(1/(1 - [[ratio]])\), whose denominator has squared modulus [[den]].
Multiplying by the conjugate puts the real part over [[den]] as [[real_num]] and the imaginary part as [[imag_num]].
